description: Create and manage Apple Wallet passes from PassSlot templates.

auth.label: App Key
auth.description: PassSlot App Key used as the HTTP Basic Auth username with an empty password. Create and manage App Keys in your PassSlot account as described at https://www.passslot.com/developer/api/start

actions.name: create_pass_from_template
actions.description: Create a Wallet pass from a PassSlot template using JSON placeholder values and return its installation URL.

values.description: The template placeholder names and JSON values to apply to the Wallet pass.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating a Wallet pass from a template.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

url.description: The short distribution URL for installing the Wallet pass.

pass.description: A Wallet pass created by PassSlot.

outputSchema.description: The newly created PassSlot Wallet pass.

actions.name: delete_pass
actions.description: Permanently delete a PassSlot Wallet pass.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

inputSchema.description: The identity of an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

deleted.description: Whether the Wallet pass was deleted.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

outputSchema.description: The acknowledgement for the deleted PassSlot Wallet pass.

actions.name: get_pass_url
actions.description: Get the short installation URL for an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

inputSchema.description: The identity of an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

url.description: The short distribution URL for installing the Wallet pass.

outputSchema.description: The PassSlot Wallet pass installation URL.

actions.name: get_pass_values
actions.description: Get the current placeholder values of an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

inputSchema.description: The identity of an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

values.description: The template placeholder names and JSON values to apply to the Wallet pass.

outputSchema.description: The current placeholder values of the PassSlot Wallet pass.

actions.name: list_pass_types
actions.description: List Apple Wallet pass type identifiers available in PassSlot.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing PassSlot pass types.

id.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

organizationName.description: The organization name from the pass certificate.

certificateExpirationDate.description: The ISO 8601 expiration timestamp of the pass certificate.

actions.name: list_passes
actions.description: List PassSlot Wallet passes, optionally limited to one pass type identifier.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing PassSlot Wallet passes.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

passType.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

actions.name: list_templates
actions.description: List PassSlot pass templates available to the connected App Key.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing PassSlot templates.

name.description: The display name of the pass template.

formatVersion.description: The Apple Wallet pass format version.

passType.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

description.description: The Apple Wallet template description and field layout.

placeholder.description: The placeholder names accepted when creating a pass from this template.

templates.description: The pass templates available to the App Key.

actions.name: update_pass_values
actions.description: Update the placeholder values of an existing PassSlot Wallet pass.

passTypeIdentifier.description: The Apple Wallet pass type identifier, such as pass.example.membership.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the Wallet pass.

values.description: The template placeholder names and JSON values to apply to the Wallet pass.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for updating PassSlot Wallet pass values.

values.description: The template placeholder names and JSON values to apply to the Wallet pass.

outputSchema.description: The placeholder values returned after the PassSlot update.
